locations.title: Pressure Activated Safe
locations.description:
To solve the puzzle and release the hostages, drop the [Orb](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494836) on top of the safe to unlock it and retrieve the key:
1. Release the [Orb](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494836) by standing on [Pressure Plate 1](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494837)
2. Activate [Pressure Plate 2](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494838) and [Pressure Plate 3](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494839)
3. Shoot to destroy [Target 1](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494842), [Target 2](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494843), and [Target 3](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494844) from the courtyard on the first floor
4. Activate the [Lever](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494834) as necessary to move the Orb through the next section
5. Activate [Pressure Plate 4](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494840) and then [Pressure Plate 5](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/golden-ridge?locationIds=494841) to drop the Orb through the hole in the floor
6. Open the safe!
